venue_reasoning.waterfront_breakwater: Italian, $$, four meat/fish-free mains, no cheese/butter/cream in the building, never had peanuts, nothing fried and light. Meets everything.
venue_reasoning.waterfront_tidewater: Meets diet, allergy, dairy, light and budget, but it is Greek; Liam steered away from the Greek place toward pasta. 2 stars.
venue_reasoning.waterfront_keel_street: Peanuts in the pesto, caponata and salad. Deal-breaker.
venue_reasoning.waterfront_marina_arch: No main without meat or fish. Deal-breaker for Mina.
venue_reasoning.waterfront_pier_nine: Dairy is the backbone of the kitchen. Costs a star for Roxy (2 stars).
venue_reasoning.waterfront_quayside: $$$, one tier over a 'nice, not fancy fancy' budget. 2 stars.
venue_reasoning.waterfront_bluewater: Everything fried, heavy (reviewer slept through alarm). Misses Brooke's light preference. 2 stars.

notes: Fair and solvable. Every decoy fails exactly one constraint, so the puzzle needs all six clues. Clues worth checking: (1) The peanut allergy holder is a bit ambiguous. Brooke is 'keeping anything peanut off our table' and tells Cyrus he's 'off duty', which suggests Cyrus normally guards it (maybe his allergy). Either way it is clearly a group-wide deal-breaker, so the pick doesn't change. (2) The Italian craving is implied ('twirling pasta' as a counter to Roxy's Greek suggestion) rather than stated outright. Tidewater is the strongest decoy, and a player who misses that line would rate it equal to Breakwater. (3) Maya's budget line ('does nice, not fancy fancy') reads as $$ and Quayside's review says it prices 'a clear notch above' the trattorias, which agrees with its $$$ card. Nothing contradictory found.
